description.value: BFF Bar & Grill is a locally owned neighborhood restaurant in Prince George, founded by three partners and built around the idea that great food is best enjoyed with good company. The menu runs from classic comfort foods and bar bites to drinks specials, with a dedicated gluten-free menu and online ordering. It bills itself as a casual all-day spot equally suited to catching a game or sitting down for a proper meal.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides consistent contact details (address, phone, email) across multiple pages. The menu page lists a 'Gluten Free Menu' section confirming GF options, and the homepage features an 'Online Order' button confirming takeout. No website content addresses bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities, so those remain null.
concerns: Website copyright footer reads 'BBF Bar and Grill' (letters transposed) rather than 'BFF Bar & Grill' — minor inconsistency on their own site, likely a typo.
OSM record contains no address or phone; contact details sourced entirely from website and cannot be cross-checked against OSM values.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible restaurant in Prince George with a confirmed address, phone, and active website. A useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a meal.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page lists a dedicated 'Gluten Free Menu' section

wow_evidence: locally owned neighborhood restaurant in Prince George
